This level of precision, applied autonomously, can directly save lives and improve public health outcomes. Allowing autonomous AI agents to make consequential decisions is about embracing superior performance in time-sensitive and complex domains, ensuring optimal outcomes where human limitations would otherwise lead to suboptimal or disastrous results.
